About Common Ground
One public plot. Four people. One deal.

The AMTS bus depot at Memnagar sits on 9,078 m² of public land, 150 m from Gujarat University Metro. This project asks whether a private partner can rebuild the depot for free and pay the city for the land, by building shops, offices and co-living above it, and on what terms the deal works for everyone.

A deal only happens if all four people say yes: the authority that owns the land, the developer who bids and builds, the investor who buys the finished building, and the buyers and renters who use it. Each page shows the deal through one of their eyes.

—FSI, setbacks and TOZ rules: CGDCR 2017
—Land value: Jantri rates, Government of Gujarat
—Cost of equity: CAPM with RBI risk-free rate and NSE market return
—Site and building: SketchUp model of FP 70, Memnagar
